verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents setting a subject line, editing email content and querying post-send statistics. None of it mentions A/B testing of subject lines or content variants, or automatic winner selection based on engagement. A/B testing is a fair axis for an email marketing product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
